mapper.insert: INSERT INTO companies ( company_name, company_abbr, status, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_email, address, license_num, note, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_del ) VALUES ( #{companyName}, #{companyAbbr}, #{status}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactEmail}, #{address}, #{licenseNum}, #{note}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now(), false )
mapper.select:

mapper.update: UPDATE companies SET company_name = #{companyName}, company_abbr = #{companyAbbr}, status = #{status}, contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, contact_email = #{contactEmail}, address = #{address}, license_num = #{licenseNum}, note = #{note}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() WHERE uuid = CAST(#{uuid} AS uuid) AND is_del = false
